item.title: Critical Apache Log4j Flaw CVE-2021-44228 Under Active Exploitation
item.description: Attackers are actively exploiting CVE-2021-44228, also tracked as Log4Shell. A follow-up issue, cve-2021-45046, was disclosed days later.
